title: The comment check catches 'red on the head' history wording in test comments
why: #1671's test comments said "RED on the head this branch starts from" in 14 blocks, which narrates history (rule building-comments-say-why). check_comment_narration passed them before and after a test-author rewrote them. Test-authors write this phrase after nearly every red run.
note: Fix: add check_comment_narration patterns for a comment that says a case is red or green on a commit or head, or fails on the base. Done check: a lint test where the phrase fails, and a control where a comment saying what a case pins passes. Extends done step comment-narration-patterns. Filed from lane notes-fix-large-3 (session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb), 19:03 CST Nov 7. #1890 replaces #1739 in this lane (coordinator, 04:28 CST Nov 8); the lane confirmed (04:29 CST): #1739 held only this step's limits note; #1890 holds that note plus two debts from #1879's round 1, narration-run-state-misses (a run's colour named after its place is missed) and narration-relative-clause-flag (a relative-clause condition is flagged).
